# 各地域の大規模層の割合
```{r}
df2 <- df2 |>
  mutate(
    share_over_5_0ha =
      entities_over_5_0ha / entities_total * 100,

    share_over_10_0ha =
      entities_over_10_0ha / entities_total * 100,

    share_over_20_0ha =
      entities_over_20_0ha / entities_total * 100,

    share_over_30_0ha =
      entities_over_30_0ha / entities_total * 100,

    share_over_50_0ha =
      entities_over_50_0ha / entities_total * 100,

    share_over_100_0ha =
```
